name: Biochemical dataset
label: Biochemical dataset
definition: Dataset on the chemical substances and vital processes occurring in living organisms.

name: Blood
label: Blood count and other lab results
definition: Blood count and other lab results, especially at the moment of hospital admission.

name: Body image
label: Body (Radiological) image
definition: Dataset containing images produced with the use of X-ray and other forms of radiant energy.

name: Clinical dataset
label: Clinical dataset
definition: Data obtained through patient examination or treatment.

name: Disease duration
label: Dataset on disease duration and disease outcome
definition: Dataset on disease duration and disease outcome

name: Environmental dataset
label: Environmental dataset
definition: Dataset on the environmental qualities which may sustain an organism or a community of organisms.

name: Genealogical records
label: Genealogical records
definition: A document about the family relationships of persons related as members of a domestic group linked through descent from a common ancestor, marriage, or adoption.

name: Genomic dataset
label: Genomic dataset
definition: Genomic data is data about the genomes of an organism.

name: IMAGING_DATA
label: Imaging data (deprecated)
definition: Deprecated value, please use a more specific imaging type instead. Y/N if imaging data are collected from the participants in the collection.

name: Lifestyle dataset
label: Lifestyle dataset
definition: Dataset on manner of living that reflects the person's values and attitudes.

name: Metabolomic dataset
label: Metabolomic dataset
definition: Dataset on the quantity and identity of all of the low molecular weight molecules in a biological entity or sample that are products of or participants in various metabolic processes.

name: NATIONAL_REGISTRIES
label: National registries (deprecated)
definition: Deprecated value, do not add to new collections. Y/N if register data is associated to the participants in the collection.

name: Not available
label: Not available
definition: Not available

name: Other sample-derived dataset
label: Other sample-derived dataset
definition: A sample-derived dataset which does not fit with any of the other dataset categories

name: Photo image
label: Photo image
definition: Dataset of photographs. Photographs are images created by projecting an image onto a photosensitive surface such as a chemically treated plate or film, CCD receptor, etc.

name: Physiological dataset
label: Physiological dataset
definition: A measurement datum that contains the assessment information about the functioning of a major organ system, the extent of disease or disability, as well as the provision and/or response to therapeutic interventions.

name: Proteomic dataset
label: Proteomic dataset
definition: Dataset on the global analysis of cellular proteins. Proteomics aims to resolve comprehensively, to quantify, and to characterize proteins.

name: Psychological dataset
label: Psychological/Neurophysiological dataset
definition: Dataset describing the behavior and mind, including conscious and unconscious phenomena, as well as feeling and thought.

name: SURVEY_DATA
label: Survey data (deprecated)
definition: Deprecated value, please use a more specific type like 'Environmental dataset' or 'Lifestyle dataset' instead. Y/N if information from surveys are collected from the participants in the sample collection/study.

name: Transcriptomic Dataset
label: Transcriptomic Dataset
definition: Transcriptomic data is data about RNA transcribed by a cell, cells or organism. This includes mRNA, tRNA and cDNA.

name: Treatment protocol
label: Treatment protocol
definition: Treatment protocol (types of drugs used)

name: Whole slide image
label: Whole slide image
definition: Dataset on images of cells or tissue sections on a slide.
